about: S-habits - Szokások (/habits), one habit (/habits/:id) and the habit sheet, design round B frames lifeos/habits-1, habit-detail, habit-form, and their undrawn states. The running dev backend has no migration 032 (B-habits-tasks is not merged), so GET /habits and GET /habits/:id are answered by contract bodies typed by lib/lifeos-api.ts (B-habits-tasks' Phase-3 block) carrying the round's Monday seed (README-ma fix rounds 1-2); every other request replays the freeze of account M. Nothing is written: no state fires a write. When the integrator records GET /habits for a seeded account, these bodies become edit lists over the recording.

habits-1.title: Szokások — a keret (hétfő, október 19.)
habits-1.why: the frame state: MA 1/3, 31 NAP, four good and two bad habits, the freeze rule, two archived. GET /habits* is answered by a contract body (the running dev backend has no migration 032 yet) -> matched-fixture at best

habit-detail.title: Nyújtás 10 perc — a keret
habit-detail.why: the frame state: 31 NAP ×1,5, 1 FAGYASZTÁS, not done today, the 12-week strip, the ledger, five history rows, the settings. GET /habits* is answered by a contract body (the running dev backend has no migration 032 yet) -> matched-fixture at best

habit-form.title: Új szokás — a lap (Adott napok, H–P)
habit-form.why: the frame state: the sheet over Szokások, Jó szokás, the name typed and focused, Adott napok with Monday..Friday, 1 / 10 / 5, the pill. GET /habits* is answered by a contract body (the running dev backend has no migration 032 yet) -> matched-fixture at best. The reminder (07:30 in the frame) stays empty: the field is the native time input (kit TimeTrigger) and the capture tool cannot type into its hour / minute segments

habits-empty.title: Szokások — még nincs szokás
habits-empty.why: no habit yet: MÉG NINCS SZOKÁSOD, one line, "+ Első szokás" (lifeos/ma-3 empty state). GET /habits* is answered by a contract body (the running dev backend has no migration 032 yet) -> matched-fixture at best

habits-failed.title: Szokások — a lekérés nem sikerült
habits-failed.why: a failed read: the danger line with "Újra" (GET /habits answered 500)

habits-archived.title: Szokások — archivált szokások kinyitva
habits-archived.why: the footer link opens the two archived habits in place, dimmed. GET /habits* is answered by a contract body (the running dev backend has no migration 032 yet) -> matched-fixture at best

habit-detail-bad.title: Esti nassolás — rossz szokás, ma visszaesés
habit-detail-bad.why: a bad habit: no pill, "Visszaestem" in danger and "Visszavonás", no schedule rows. GET /habits* is answered by a contract body (the running dev backend has no migration 032 yet) -> matched-fixture at best

habit-edit.title: Nyújtás 10 perc — szerkesztés
habit-edit.why: a settings row opens the same sheet in edit mode: no kind switch, "Mentés". GET /habits* is answered by a contract body (the running dev backend has no migration 032 yet) -> matched-fixture at best

habit-gone.title: Szokás — nem érhető el (404)
habit-gone.why: a habit that is not there, or another account's (the same 404, anti-IDOR): the danger line 'Ez a szokás nem érhető el' with the way back to Szokások, nothing to retry (review S-habits D7)
